FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL FUNDING OPPORTUNITY
Source ID: notice-v1
Community Resilience Pilot — original notice, October 1, 2026

1. Eligibility
An application must be submitted by a university research office. Each university
may submit one application. This notice does not specify citizenship eligibility.

2. Dates
The sponsor deadline is November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.
The institutional review deadline is November 9, 2026 at noon Pacific Time.
The project period is July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028.

3. Budget
The maximum direct-cost request is $180,000. Indirect costs are additional and
may not exceed 25% of direct costs. Equipment purchases are not permitted.
Travel and subaward costs are allowed within the direct-cost limit.
This notice does not give an exception or waiver process.

4. Required material
Include a project narrative, an itemized budget, a budget justification and one
signed community-partner letter. The letter must arrive with the application.
The notice does not specify a page limit for the budget justification.
